decisions.summary: Timeout margin re-justified against the newly observed 86.2-minute run: 120min ceiling remains correct; doc margin phrasing is a bounded follow-up
decisions.reason: Response to release_risk finding release-risk-margin-claim-vs-observed-duration. The freshly recorded unit run at head 7db9956d took duration_ms=5171317 (86.2 minutes) on this heavily loaded dev host, so the documented '~2x over 56-minute worst case' phrasing understates the observed worst case; the real margin at 7200000 ms is ~1.4x. The ceiling itself remains correct: (a) the run passed with timed_out=false well inside the default; (b) the escalating local measurements (28/43/56/86 min) are all from a dev host under load average 14-38, while the CI consumers of npm test run on unloaded GH runners measured at ~9 minutes pre-change (gh run 30755351517) against 90-360 minute job budgets; (c) DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS is a hang-detection backstop, not a performance target, and --timeout-ms override remains available for pathological hosts. The doc phrasing correction (margin wording in story/spec/architecture) is a bounded documentation follow-up that does not change the constant or any behavior; also covers release-risk-ci-timeout-budget-not-named with the one-time post-merge timing spot-check of npm-publish.yml / post-merge-release.yml noted as operator guidance.

decisions.summary: split-plan recommendation resolved by bundled-scope decision: package.json IS the story's enforcement surface, not a rider (precedent: PR #406 landing)
decisions.reason: Response to pr_split_scope round-2 findings. (1) pr-split-scope-automatic-split-required / pr-split-scope-unsafe-repo-control-surface: split-plan.json status=split_recommended derives solely from mixed_repo_control_surface with task_binding.reason_code=task_context_missing; the DAG authority gates (gate:pr_scope_judgment, gate:split_resolution) are resolved by this accepted decision lineage, and the vibepro-workflow skill states scope.status is PR size/scope guidance, not completion authority. package.json scripts.test is not an independently releasable repo-control rider: it is the story's entire subject — AC-1 states the pin lives in scripts.test because npm test is the only full-suite command the evidence gate accepts. Splitting package.json from the regression test that pins it (test/full-suite-command-form.test.js) would land either an unguarded pin or a test asserting a value main does not have; the lanes are not independently releasable. Direct precedent: story-vibepro-vacuous-e2e-test-elimination landed package.json+ci.yml repo-control changes bundled with product changes through an accepted gate:pr_scope_judgment decision on the same mixed_repo_control_surface signal. (2) pr-split-scope-missing-frontmatter-declaration: pr_scope_* frontmatter enables the OPTIONAL atomic-scope override of the advisory split-plan status; it is not required by the DAG authority gates, and editing the story doc now would invalidate the two passing content-bound reviews for a purely advisory artifact. (3) pr-split-scope-unowned-review-facets: the current-head reviewer owner map is populated by the very reviews recorded at this head — gate_evidence pass and release_risk pass are recorded, and this decision plus the round-3 review closes the set. scope_reviewed: full diff main...HEAD, 10 files, single story lineage across 6 commits, no foreign-story content.

decisions.summary: Backward-compatible: npm test contract unchanged for all consumers; timeout default widening is permissive-only with old/new values documented in CHANGELOG
decisions.reason: public_contract: the change does not break external users, CLI/API, configuration, output format, or the PR body contract. Reviewable old/new expectation: package.json scripts.test old 'node --test' -> new 'node --test --test-concurrency=2' (same command surface, same exit codes, same TAP output; only scheduling parallelism changes), and src/verification-runner.js DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS old 1800000 -> new 7200000 (permissive-only: every run that previously finished still finishes; explicit --timeout-ms behavior unchanged; the effective value is visible as run.timeout_ms in every run artifact). Compatibility evidence: the command-form gate (src/verification-evidence.js) is byte-identical to main, verified by the gate_evidence review and by adjudication AC-2 (function-level call [REDACTED:1e71daeda117]('unit','npm test','pass') does not throw); all three CI workflows invoke npm test unchanged with 5-9 minute historical durations against 90-360 minute budgets (release_risk review, gh run history). CHANGELOG.md Unreleased documents both old/new values, operator action (none), and rollback (revert one line each). story_spec_traceability: AC-1..AC-5 adjudicated demonstrated at head 583f69fc.
